what_happened: After handoff, the ego braked hard behind lead vehicle 1 (from 7.9 to about 3.5 m/s) and steered left toward the lane line instead of holding its lane. At 7.5 s it was about 1.1 m left of the recorded path, and its front-left side hit vehicle 33, which was coming up in the left lane.

The route said STRAIGHT on a multi-lane highway, but after handoff the ego braked from 16 to 10 m/s and its planned path wandered left, away from the recorded straight path. It drifted into the left neighbouring lane and its front hit actor 1, the car alongside it there, at 8.0 s. The rear contact came after this collision, and the lead car 50+ m ahead played no part.

On a straight, open highway the ego slowed for no clear reason, from 16.7 to 10.4 m/s, with no lead within about 50 m. At the same time it drifted left toward the lane line, and its front-left corner hit actor 1 as that car came up alongside in the left lane. A rear contact was also recorded, but the front collision began first.

On a straight highway with no close lead (gap over 49 m), the ego braked steadily from 16.6 to 10.1 m/s for no clear reason and fell about 12 m behind the recorded position. While braking, its planned path drifted left toward the lane line, and its front-left corner ran into vehicle 1, which was travelling alongside in the left lane. The later rear contact came after this front collision, and it is likely a result of the ego's unneeded braking.

On a multi-lane freeway the ego braked hard behind lead car 1, from 7.9 to about 3.7 m/s, so it was going much slower than the recorded drive. At 7.5 s, actor 33 in the left lane came up from behind and sideswiped the ego's left rear quarter while the ego was angled slightly right, away from it. The run also flags a rear contact, which fits a log-replayed actor that doesn't react driving into a car slower than the recorded one.

After handoff, the ego braked hard behind lead vehicle 1, slowing from 7.9 to about 3.6 m/s, while drifting left about 1.1 m from the recorded path until it straddled the line with the left lane. Vehicle 33 was coming up from behind in the left lane, on a replayed path that doesn't react to the ego, and the two side-swiped (a lateral collision at the ego's left rear).

The command was RIGHT and the recorded path moved right toward actor 5's lane, but the ego, crawling at about 3.5 m/s in slow highway traffic, stayed in its own lane. Its path then bent left, and its front corner clipped car 51 as that car passed close by in the lane to the left. Nothing was close ahead in the ego's lane (gap about 36 m).

On a congested multi-lane highway with a RIGHT command, the ego did not follow the recorded path to the right. It crept forward at about 3–4 m/s and drifted about 1.8 m left, onto the line of the lane to its left, where actor 51 was overtaking it. The ego's front corner hit actor 51 as it came alongside.

In slow, congested highway traffic (about 3–4 m/s), the ego drifted left of the recorded trajectory, ending about 1.9 m off it, even though the route command was RIGHT. It moved into the lane to its left and made front contact with actor 51, which was coming up alongside in that lane.

The ego was creeping through dense highway traffic at about 3–4 m/s with a RIGHT command. Instead of following its path to the right, it drifted left toward the lane line, ending up about 1.8 m left of the recorded human trajectory. Its front corner hit actor 51, which was driving alongside in the adjacent left lane.
